name: Backblaze B2
description: Backblaze B2 native API. Only the b2_authorize_account exchange is expressible in Connector Spec v1: that call takes Basic keyID:applicationKey and returns a short-lived session authorizationToken PLUS a per-account apiUrl host, and every other B2 call (b2_list_buckets, b2_list_file_names, b2_get_file_info) needs both of those values. A spec cannot chain one call's response into a later call's host and Authorization header, so no read tools are declared here. The S3-compatible endpoint is no escape: it requires AWS SigV4 request signing, which v1 also cannot express. BLOCKED pending a session-exchange auth type (exchange once, cache the token, take base_url from the exchange response).
